blurb: Guests can take private or group horse riding lessons, lease horses, and participate in summer camps for various skill levels. The farm offers pony rides and birthday parties, as well as competitive riding teams for middle school, high school, and college students. Lessons focus on developing horse and rider skills with experienced instructors.
extraNote: Contact farm for lesson pricing and scheduling · Inform instructor or barn at least one day in advance if missing a lesson · Make-up lessons offered for lessons cancelled by AMIT · IEA membership fee $55 yearly, monthly practice fee $180, show entries approx. $80 each · At the barn, check in at the aisle for notices and information.
